platform: Remote Linux x86_64 workspace and GitHub Actions Ubuntu 24.04; no live Omarchy, physical tablet or ARM64 session

results.name: Portable tests
checks: 53 Node tests plus geometry/configuration/editor assertions, Bash syntax and Lua fixture checks pass.
11 touch tests cover mode/output choice, target geometry, cancellation, settings migration/conflicts, bounded literal IPC, stale targets, provider selection and minimised-window restoration.

results.name: QML parsing
checks: All root QML files parse with the Qt parser in GitHub Actions.

results.name: Qt event tests with theme/UI stubs
checks: TouchWheel: pointer/raw-touch tap, opt-in drag, cancel, hold-to-edit, rotation cancellation and compact grid.
TouchHome: navigation/search, keyboard requests, confirmed close, focus/busy actions and a small viewport.
results.scope: Qt offscreen/software event delivery with host component stubs; not physical touch or Omarchy acceptance.

results.name: Manifest and publish-surface validation
checks: Strict structural/publish checks pass with no structural errors or warnings.
Advisory capability flags remain for local processes/collected output, installers, authoring files and CI package installation. These are not a security audit.

results.name: Static release preflight
checks: Clean, version-consistent candidate passes static preflight; native acceptance and release-tag gates remain pending.

pending: Native Omarchy load/render, focus restoration and touch overlay/keyboard layering.
Physical touch press, cancellation, long press, rotation, portrait/landscape and accessibility.
Real OmaTouch and Tablet Mode keyboard operations, provider loss/recovery, app text entry and Wi-Fi password entry.
Real window restoration/movement/close, brightness/audio/media and rotation controls.
Gesture/editor/upgrade/fresh-install regression harnesses on the new candidate.
Fractional scaling, physical multi-monitor, hotplug, shell reload, disable/removal and idle/battery observations.
ARM64/iPad mini 4 graphics, touch mapping and end-to-end tablet acceptance.
Secure keyboard-free login, suspend/wake and unlock; inspected Omarchy lock view has no on-screen keyboard.
limitations: Qt event tests use real Qt input delivery with theme/UI stubs, not Quickshell, the Omarchy shell, or real keyboard providers.
Helper tests replace IPC commands with controlled fixtures; source inspection is not native integration acceptance.
Automatic mode requires enabled Tablet Mode and a definite folded observation from a real fold sensor. Persistent Touch is the choice for tablets without one.
Normal overlay keyboards cannot provide secure lock-screen input. No authentication bypass is implemented.
No claim of official Omarchy tablet-default adoption, confirmed iPad support, marketplace approval or security audit.
No v0.3.0 release authorization for pending-live gaps has been recorded. The branch remains a draft candidate.
review_notes: Touch helper operations use whitelisted verbs and argument arrays; validates fresh resources; bounds subprocess time and output; no eval, installation or privilege escalation.
View actions are serialized and generation-scoped; late responses do not change a reopened view. Status discovery is read-only.
Authoring/test files flagged by advisory scanning are repository sources; do not treat the complete source archive as an installable runtime bundle.
